_comment: Metric library. 'column' is the header in the Wisehockey match statistics CSV. Metrics with 'goalkeeper': true use columns counted from the match events CSV instead (see _load_goalie_stats in content.py) and are ranked among goalkeepers only. Definitions follow 'wh_portal Data Dictionaries 2026.pdf' (section 9), rewritten in plain language. 'events' lists the kinds of match events behind a metric (goal, assist, shot, save, goal_against, shot_against, faceoff_win; hardest_shot = the single fastest shot), so the card detail page can list them and link to video. Metrics without 'events' cannot be traced to single events.

metrics.label: Goals
metrics.definition: How many times the player put the puck in the opponent's net.
metrics.source_definition: G — Number of goals scored by a player

metrics.label: Assists
metrics.definition: Credited when the player passed, shot or touched the puck in a way that set up a teammate's goal.
metrics.source_definition: A — Number of assists received from shooting, passing or deflecting the puck towards the scoring teammate or touching it in any other way which enabled a goal

metrics.label: Points
metrics.definition: Goals plus assists. The simplest measure of how many goals a player was directly involved in.
metrics.source_definition: P — Number of points received by a player for goals scored or assists earned

metrics.label: Shots
metrics.definition: How many shots the player took. More shots usually means more pressure on the opposing goalkeeper.
metrics.source_definition: S — Number of a player's shots

metrics.label: Hardest shot
metrics.definition: The speed of the player's fastest shot in the game, measured by puck tracking.
metrics.source_definition: S TOP — Player's hardest shot

metrics.label: Expected goals (xG)
metrics.definition: Every shot gets a probability of becoming a goal, based on distance, angle, passes before the shot, screens and the goalkeeper's position. xG adds those up: 0.60 xG means the player's chances were worth about 0.6 goals on average.
metrics.source_definition: xGsum — Sum of a player's all shot xG values

metrics.label: Top skating speed
metrics.definition: The fastest the player skated at any moment in the game.
metrics.source_definition: SPD TOP — Player's top speed (km/h)

metrics.label: Distance skated
metrics.definition: The total distance the player skated during the game. It reflects workload and ice time.
metrics.source_definition: DIST — Total distance a player traveled on the ice (m)

metrics.label: Time on ice
metrics.definition: How long the player was on the ice in total. Coaches give the most ice time to players they trust.
metrics.source_definition: TOI — Player's time on the ice in total

metrics.label: Blocked shots
metrics.definition: How many opponent shots the player stopped with their body or stick before they reached the goal. It is a defensive sacrifice.
metrics.source_definition: BKS — Number of shots blocked by a player

metrics.label: Faceoff win %
metrics.definition: Share of faceoffs (the puck drop that restarts play) the player won. Winning the faceoff gives your team the puck.
metrics.source_definition: FOW% — Faceoff win percentage (per a player's all faceoffs)

metrics.label: Pass success
metrics.definition: Share of the player's passes that reached a teammate.
metrics.source_definition: Pass% — Percentage of successful passes per a player's all passes

metrics.label: Successful passes
metrics.definition: How many of the player's passes reached a teammate.
metrics.source_definition: Passes — Successful passes per a player's all passes

metrics.label: Puck battles won
metrics.definition: How many times the player won a contested puck, a one-on-one fight for a loose puck.
metrics.source_definition: PCW — Number of a player's puck contest wins

metrics.label: Saves
metrics.definition: Shots on goal the goalkeeper stopped.
metrics.source_definition: Counted from match events: Shot events with ShotResult 'Saved' where the player is the goalkeeper

metrics.label: Shots on goal faced
metrics.definition: Shots that would have gone in without a save. More shots faced means a busier night in net.
metrics.source_definition: Counted from match events: Shot events with ShotResult 'Saved' or 'Goal' where the player is the goalkeeper

metrics.label: Shot attempts faced
metrics.definition: Every shot the opponent aimed at this goalkeeper's net, including shots that were blocked or missed.
metrics.source_definition: Counted from match events: all Shot events where the player is the goalkeeper

metrics.label: Save percentage
metrics.definition: Share of shots on goal the goalkeeper stopped.
metrics.source_definition: Saves divided by shots on goal faced, counted from match events

metrics.label: Average pass body pressure relief
metrics.definition: Opposing skaters within 3 m at pass release minus those within 3 m of the receiver in the first later snapshot within 2 seconds. Only successful passes; goalkeepers excluded. Positive values indicate pressure relief. Missing observations are excluded.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined PBP using Wisehockey event snapshots; reception time is estimated, not directly observed.

metrics.label: Pressure-reducing passes
metrics.definition: Opposing skaters within 3 m at pass release minus those within 3 m of the receiver in the first later snapshot within 2 seconds. Only successful passes; goalkeepers excluded. Positive values indicate pressure relief. Missing observations are excluded.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined PBP using Wisehockey event snapshots; reception time is estimated, not directly observed.

metrics.label: Evaluated passes
metrics.definition: Opposing skaters within 3 m at pass release minus those within 3 m of the receiver in the first later snapshot within 2 seconds. Only successful passes; goalkeepers excluded. Positive values indicate pressure relief. Missing observations are excluded.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined PBP using Wisehockey event snapshots; reception time is estimated, not directly observed.

metrics.label: Average pass packing
metrics.definition: Signed number of opposing skaters whose release-time x positions lie strictly between passer and reception positions. Forward bypasses are positive; backward passes restoring opponents ahead of the puck are negative. Goalkeepers excluded. Reception uses the first later snapshot within 2 seconds.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined longitudinal packing, with opponent positions frozen at pass release. Not a measure of passing lanes or defender movement.

metrics.label: Total pass packing
metrics.definition: Signed number of opposing skaters whose release-time x positions lie strictly between passer and reception positions. Forward bypasses are positive; backward passes restoring opponents ahead of the puck are negative. Goalkeepers excluded. Reception uses the first later snapshot within 2 seconds.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined longitudinal packing, with opponent positions frozen at pass release. Not a measure of passing lanes or defender movement.

metrics.label: Positive-packing passes
metrics.definition: Signed number of opposing skaters whose release-time x positions lie strictly between passer and reception positions. Forward bypasses are positive; backward passes restoring opponents ahead of the puck are negative. Goalkeepers excluded. Reception uses the first later snapshot within 2 seconds.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined longitudinal packing, with opponent positions frozen at pass release. Not a measure of passing lanes or defender movement.

metrics.label: Expected assists (xA)
metrics.definition: The last successful pass to the shooter within four seconds before a shot receives its xG as expected assists, unless opponent possession intervenes. Each shot is credited once; missing xG is excluded.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined expected assists using Wisehockey shot xG and pass/control events.

metrics.label: Shots set up
metrics.definition: The last successful pass to the shooter within four seconds before a shot receives its xG as expected assists, unless opponent possession intervenes. Each shot is credited once; missing xG is excluded.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined expected assists using Wisehockey shot xG and pass/control events.

metrics.label: Average xG of shots set up
metrics.definition: The last successful pass to the shooter within four seconds before a shot receives its xG as expected assists, unless opponent possession intervenes. Each shot is credited once; missing xG is excluded.
metrics.source_definition: Project-defined expected assists using Wisehockey shot xG and pass/control events.
